limits: Historical slide-traced channel grid, not surveyed detector coordinates.
Physical mapping established here for109APA2andOctober104APA1only; other endpoints shown in electronics order.
Self-triggered gaps/selection; absent channels do not imply no light.
Shared fixed channel pedestal can be uncertain; its provenance retained perchannel.
512ns snapshot sampling can miss a narrow peak or channels with timing offsets.
ADC rail flags indicate codes0/16383, not proof of analog saturation; rails can reflect digitization faults.
No calibrated gains/photoelectrons; amplitude cannot be equated with light energy.
No optical-origin or source-localization claim from spatial profiles alone.
Disconnected-input status comes from user plus slide23, not independently read engineering report.
